envelope.description: Wire the optional LifecycleService into the approval and review paths

body.title: Wire the optional LifecycleService into the approval and review paths
body.summary: Add the optional lifecycle?: LifecycleService field to WorkflowApproveRequest and reviewArtifactFile's arguments: with it the full log-tail check runs, the approval is applied through LifecycleService.apply, completeIfRolledUp is called after a BUILD record approval, and when a service is supplied ensureBuildRecordOnCompletion's persist and reviewArtifactFile's auto-fix write through the service's ArtifactStore (a content update that appends the revision-bearing entry) instead of writeArtifact so the log stays in step; without a service they keep writeArtifact and behaviour is as after t9. The legacy meta.approvedAt stamp still follows. Binding requirement 3.
acceptanceChecks: with a service, an explicit override over an advisory-blocked code review completes the Story through a real approval and the override reason is on the complete entry
with a service, a review auto-fix or BUILD hook rewrite on a head with existing history leaves the next service approval ok, not head-ahead-of-log
without a service the approval and review paths behave as after t9 and the legacy meta.approvedAt is still stamped
